description:
First step of bd:JMAP-510h.14 (MockBackend removal). Migrate the unit tests in src/filenode.rs that use MockBackend without any fault-injection or override knobs (i.e. tests that only call MockBackend::new() / new_with_account()).

These are the 'easy' migrations — straight swap of MockBackend for MemoryBackend, since MemoryBackend already supports new()/with_account().

Audit list (run grep 'MockBackend::new' src/filenode.rs to enumerate). Roughly ~22 of the 30 tests.

After this bead: remaining tests use add_get_objects_node, set_descendants, set_sibling, set_ancestor, set_get_ancestors_err, set_blob_exists_err, or set_create_object_override_name. Those are handled in subsequent sibling beads.
title: filenode-server: migrate unit tests in src/filenode.rs from MockBackend to MemoryBackend (no-fault-injection tests)
